title: A new ceramic Apple Watch could go on sale soon - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple first offered a white ceramic option with Apple Watch Series 2, added a black ceramic variant with the Series 3, dropped both ceramic colors entirely for the Series 4, only to bring a white ceramic option only with the Series 5.
